generation.mode: built-in ImageGen edit with the edit target first and the canon second as reference only

lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; final water-mask pixels and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No whole-cell sun gradient or long cast-shadow field is visible, but repeated pale column caps above darker vertical faces create a consistent upper-face value bias. The aggregate metric cannot override the literal no-lit-side requirement.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land area at native source resolution
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: The broad level grass-and-bare-rock plateau counts as buildable; the east cliff faces and taller west outcrop faces count as steep; conifer gullies, talus, and broken rock make up the remainder.

north.required: land continues through the north edge

east.required: sea across the east edge with terrain ending before it

south.required: the coastal landform and its east sea continue through the south edge

west.required: settlement-shelf land continues through the west edge

crown.method: Manual apex-by-apex outer-foliage census of all 31 visible crowns at native 1254 px, including clipped crowns and saplings; median source width 32 px scaled by 2560/1254 and 0.048 m per final pixel.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.method: Flooded the edge-connected teal sea from the east edge, grew through qualified cool surf and foam pixels, and filled enclosed wet speckles; the resulting binary boundary includes the full painted surf, wash, ripples, and reflections while retaining dry rocks and column bases.

siteChecks.plainCliffTopBench: present, but much broader than the requested narrow bench
siteChecks.colonnadeHead: absent: there is no last land column followed by a first linked sea stack with adjacent level viewing ground
siteChecks.railCliffRunLandform: partial: level ground reaches the cliff top, but a distinct narrow ledge above the sea is not clearly drawn

refusalReasons: The generated columns are upright repeated cliff buttresses, not equal columns all leaning south-east and touching their immediate neighbors at the top to form a walkable arcade.
The chain does not leave land as linked sea stacks and continue past the east edge; consequently the required colonnade-head site is absent.
The east edge contains 140 land pixels, while the brief requires the east edge to be sea.

Repeated pale column caps above darker vertical faces violate the highest-priority equal-value-on-all-sides lighting rule. The packet permits a retry only for a non-square result, so no corrective ImageGen call was made.
openRisks: The broad level plateau does not match the requested narrow, quiet cliff-top bench and visually competes with the intended linear wonder.
The water mask was inspected against a native-resolution overlay and passes its mechanical checks, but coastline judgment remains a director and owner visual decision.
Exact seam quality, ground scale, and overall visual quality remain director and owner judgments; quarantine evidence does not establish visual acceptance.
